description: Tasks for the StreamShield Azure and Microsoft Fabric modernization plan.

tasks.description: Capture current behavior of the in-scope Python backend before migration.
tasks.requirements: Create a frozen behavior specification and mock/real decision table for external dependencies used by migration verification. Operate on a snapshot of backend/ only. Do not modify application code.

tasks.description: Prepare Bicep and connectivity design for the future Azure and Fabric environment without provisioning.
tasks.requirements: Prepare the Azure Container Apps API and worker, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Managed Redis, private networking, monitoring, and required application configuration. Document how Fabric capacity/workspace/pipeline will be configured using supported Azure/Fabric management interfaces; do not assume Bicep covers Fabric workspace items. Keep provisioning disabled and do not include resource IDs, subscription IDs, connection strings, or secrets. East US is only a pricing reference; deployment region, resource group, SKUs, and sizes remain unconfirmed.

tasks.description: Move the StreamShield operational and dimensional PostgreSQL database from Render to Azure Database for PostgreSQL.
tasks.requirements: Migrate the in-scope Python backend's PostgreSQL connectivity and data service while preserving application behavior, schema, and data. Use managed identity where supported, configure private connectivity, and define a verified data migration/cutover procedure. Do not change backend-spring, frontend hosting, or the analytics destination in this task. Do not provision resources or include credentials or resource IDs.

tasks.description: Move the StreamShield API and worker Redis connectivity from Render to Azure Managed Redis.
tasks.requirements: Migrate Redis connectivity while preserving queue, cache, worker, and required TCP behavior. Use managed identity and TLS where supported; document private network access and failover behavior. Do not provision Azure resources or include secrets or resource IDs.

tasks.description: Replace the optional BigQuery replication flow with a Microsoft Fabric Warehouse analytics pipeline.
tasks.requirements: Use the existing PostgreSQL dimensional warehouse as the source for Fabric Warehouse. Replace the manual/daily BigQuery synchronization with a supported, monitored Fabric ingestion and refresh path. Migrate required history, compare row counts and analytical results against the source, and retain tenant isolation equivalent to the current tenant-scoped BigQuery datasets. Document identity, private connectivity, retry, scheduling, retention, cost, and rollback requirements. Do not disable or remove BigQuery production behavior until parity and cutover are verified. No resource provisioning or credentials in source control.

tasks.description: Retarget the Power BI project to Fabric and preserve secure application embedding.
tasks.requirements: Update the existing PBIP data source from BigQuery to the Fabric Warehouse destination. Validate model, measures, report refresh, and tenant-specific authorization against migrated data. Complete the app-owns-data embedding flow only after the Power BI workspace, report, identity, capacity/licensing, and viewer model are confirmed. Keep secrets server-side and out of source control/browser code. The frontend remains hosted on Vercel; do not claim a live report or embedding connection until verified.

tasks.description: Build integration tests for the migrated Azure services and Fabric analytics path, then verify behavior.
tasks.requirements: Use mock mode while no Azure/Fabric environment is available. Verify API/worker service boundaries, PostgreSQL and Redis behavior, Fabric ingestion/data parity, Power BI source and embedding contracts, and tenant-isolation cases. Reuse the frozen behavior specification and external-dependency decision table from setupBaseline. Do not provision resources or store identifiers, connection strings, or secrets.

tasks.description: Scan and remediate dependency vulnerabilities in the in-scope migration components.
tasks.requirements: Scan dependencies for the Python backend and any frontend dependencies changed for Power BI embedding. Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to patched versions and verify applicable builds/tests. Exclude backend-spring and unrelated security scope.

tasks.description: Prepare and, after separate authorization, deploy the Python API and worker to Azure Container Apps.
tasks.requirements: Complete the future deployment only after the user approves the itemized cost estimate and confirms subscription, region, resource group, sizing, image registry, and required service identities. Until then, keep provisioning disabled and make no cloud changes. Migrate data and cut over only after tested parity, rollback, private connectivity, monitoring, and Power BI/Fabric access are verified. Keep the frontend on Vercel.
tasks.resourceStatus: No Azure or Fabric resources are provisioned by this plan; deployment is gated on cost review and separate explicit authorization.
